text:
max_sales: Deal closed with HelioCore. Committed to Dedicated plan with private VPC + SSO + KMS. Passing to CS/Eng for onboarding. Quick context: using llm-v2.2 (8-bit quant), expected steady 20 qps, spike up to ~60 qps during launch. 99th latency SLO target <120ms. Renewal in Q1 2026 (12mo). Contacts: @mira_csm (CS), @kevin_eng (Eng). LOA here: https://redwood.co/deals/HC-214 :tada:

mira_csm: Thanks — I’ll own onboarding. Initial checklist I’ll run through: provisioning, SSO config and test accounts, KMS/HSM setup, network peering, model pinning/versioning, and a load-testing window. Scheduling kickoff Mon 10am PT. @tony_support can you own support triage + escalation path for early incidents? :eyes:

ton y_support: On it. I’ll draft the support playbook and an incident runbook for alert thresholds. Need expected token rates, model size, and any platform constraints. Paste expected numbers?

max_sales: qps ~20 sustained, bursts up to 60 for first 2 weeks. Model KV cache ~6GB/host. Customer will route PII through platform so KMS + audit logs required. They also requested weekly exec summaries on cost/perf.

kevin_eng: For private VPC we’ll need subnet CIDR, allowed egress, and whether they want HSM-backed KMS (longer lead time). I’ll open infra ticket. Example network rules they can mirror: ```egress: tcp 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 (nat) inbound: 203.0.113.0/24 -> allow management IPs``` Also note we’ll need VPN peering details if on-prem.

rachel_ops: Flagging renewal risk: contract has a 30% concession tied to performance. If we hit perf regressions early, renewal risk goes high. Recommend 30-day health check + biweekly quality evaluations. Capture NPS at day 14 and day 60.

mira_csm: Owners summary: Onboarding lead = mira_csm; Eng owner = kevin_eng; Support owner = tony_support; Renewal/watch = rachel_ops. Next steps (owners): 1) Share repo access + API keys (max_sales) 2) Provision VPC and DNS (kevin_eng) 3) SSO test users + metadata (mira_csm) 4) KMS cert exchange (customer + kevin_eng) 5) Run load test and measure latency/cost (eng + support) 6) Collect evaluation prompt set and success criteria (customer + mira_csm). I’ll create a persistent ticket and add owners/times.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-4781 'HelioCore - Dedicated onboarding runbook' assigned to mira_csm, kevin_eng, tony_support. Link: https://redwood.co/board/CS-4781

max_sales: Customer asked for a weekly summary email to their execs; include a cost delta estimate post-quantization and a short incident contact list. I’ll draft the template and share.

mira_csm: I’ll take the email draft. @kevin_eng can you give an ETA for adding per-route latency and token-cost panels in Console? Need something by Friday so we can show a live dashboard at the first enablement.

kevin_eng: ETA Friday EOD for an initial dashboard (latency by route, token breakdown, 99th percentiles). I’ll need sample request logs or a small synthetic trace; please drop earliest logs into CS-4781.

ton y_support: I’ll prepare synthetic checks and can run smoke tests post-provision. Also proposing a short rollback playbook if the quantized variant underperforms: fallback to float model + throttled traffic for 24h while we debug.

mira_csm: :thumbsup: Adding all of these as action items in CS-4781. Plan: Kickoff Mon -> infra green (T+2 days) -> enablement session T+3 days -> feedback capture at day 14. Survey question for feedback: 'Is inference reliable for your core workflow?' (yes/partially/no + comment).

rachel_ops: Marking this account with tag 'renewal-risk:watch' and escalating to renewal team until adoption thresholds are met. Will evaluate after 30/60/90 day checkpoints.

max_sales: Thanks team — I’ll drop initial access + contract scan into CS-4781 tonight. If any blockers before kickoff, ping me.

mira_csm: Thanks — will post the kickoff agenda and owners timeline in the ticket.
notes: This thread contains the root message plus replies for the HelioCore sales-to-CS handoff and CS-to-support/eng coordination. It captures owners, next steps, technical constraints (VPC/SSO/KMS), load expectations, and renewal risk precautions.
